measure: P(the selection goes two goals up AND does not win), per match, unconditional
notes: INITIAL values (5 Nov 2026), not yet measured. Shaped from the published base rate (~1.8% of matches see a two-goal lead not converted, ~5-7% of two-goal leads) split by how often a side of that strength goes two up. Tuned by hand against Bookie Bashing's 2-up tracker with render/api/tools/twoup_backtest.py --merge; BB bans automated access, so that comparison is always user-triggered. 'default' applies to a probability outside every bucket.
